source.title: IndexOperation lazy promise does not forward execute() rejection (source unchanged in @n8n/db1.47.4)

labels.name: status:in-linear
labels.description: Issue or PR is now in Linear

source.body:
### Bug Description

In a controlled fictional migration fixture using n8n2.44.6, two rows conflicting with a unique signing-key metadata index caused an unhandled QueryFailedError/SQLITE_CONSTRAINT and child termination. No production records were used.

The installed @n8n/db1.47.4 from n8n2.47.6 has the identical dist/migrations/dsl/indices.js SHA256 C53D3A94BA88079DB74009A8EAD77B03C4048FDCEE5F2C20709296A2C1DDBA63. Its IndexOperation constructor uses super((resolve) => { void this.execute(queryRunner).then(resolve); }); with no rejection forwarding. The full duplicate-data failure has not been rerun against2.47.6; unchanged helper source is the observation, not a new whole-executor failure claim.

### To Reproduce

Historical controlled fixture, not a fresh2.47.6 reproduction:
1. Use fictional active signing-key metadata rows with the same type/algorithm, conflicting with the intended unique index.
2. Apply the selected index migration in the isolated2.44.6 fixture child.
3. The recorded result was an unhandled QueryFailedError/SQLITE_CONSTRAINT and child termination.

The complete duplicate-data failure has not been rerun on2.47.6. No production data or private logs are included.

### Expected behavior

Could maintainers confirm the intended rejection handling and identify a maintained fix/release or a supported migration-precondition approach? No vendor code has been patched. Empty-profile startup success does not establish duplicate-data migration recovery.

### Debug Info

Manually redacted version/source summary; raw About/debug output is not included.
Historical fixture: n8n2.44.6, Node24.22.1, sqlite3 package5.1.7 (SQLite3.44.2).
Current source comparison: n8n2.47.6, @n8n/db1.47.4, @n8n/typeorm0.14.0. Empty-profile smoke used Node24.22.3/SQLite3.44.2; this was not the duplicate-data regression.
No account IDs, workflow IDs, private paths, backups, keys or credentials are included.

### Operating System

Windows (local isolated test environment)

### n8n Version

2.44.6 historical fixture;2.47.6 source comparison only

### Node.js Version

24.22.1 historical fixture;24.22.3 empty-profile smoke

### Database

SQLite (default)

### Execution mode

main (default)

### Hosting

self hosted
